name: Osman Gedik
hook: The Architect & Strategic Leader. The Engineer who treats gastronomy not as a café business, but as a scalable technology ecosystem. Osman built the supply chain monopoly and the "App-First" strategy that defines Rasa.
title: Engineering a Global Brand – From Supply Chain Monopoly to Shared Ownership
bioHtml:
• The Engineer’s Mindset: Osman Gedik is a calculated disruptor. Holding a B.Eng. in IT Forensics and an M.Eng. in IT Security, his professional DNA is defined by logic, systems, and precision. He viewed the coffee market as a "system error" he could fix. His thesis: "Do not run this as a café. Build it like a Tech Company." This led to a radical focus on automation, data-driven consistency, and an "Application First" approach.

  • The "Core 8" Strategy: Osman understood that a billion-dollar vision cannot be executed alone. Instead of hiring managers, he recruited Entrepreneurs. He granted shares to every Core Member, ensuring they are partners with "skin in the game." This guarantees absolute loyalty and innovation across every department.

  • Global Supply Chain Monopoly: Osman’s genius extends to logistics. He founded a separate export company in Indonesia to eliminate middlemen. Through high-level negotiations, he secured exclusive distribution rights for Europe, Türkiye, and the GCC for key ingredients.

  • The Vision: "I will be the next Starbucks for specialty coffee, but with a completely different methodology." Today, backed by a team of co-owners and a secured supply chain, he has engineered a foundation ready to dominate the global market.

name: Renie Arfianti
hook: The Origin Specialist. Bridges architectural precision with direct access to exclusive plantations. She doesn't just design spaces; she engineers efficient workflows that maximize revenue per square meter.
title: Designing High-Performance Spaces & Securing the Supply Chain
bioHtml:
• The Authority in Design: Renie is a powerhouse in spatial design with over a decade of experience leading major projects for the Indonesian government. She understands how to manage large-scale projects and deliver results that function on a national level.

  • Strategic Design (Workflow meets Psychology): Most designers make spaces look good; Renie makes them work. She optimizes layouts for barista workflow efficiency, ensuring speed and ease of movement which directly impacts revenue per hour. Simultaneously, she curates the atmosphere to guide customer spending behavior.

  • The Gateway to Origin: Renie acts as the primary diplomat between Rasa Group and the source. She communicates directly with farmers and acts as the gatekeeper to Indonesia’s best plantations. Her network allows Rasa Group to bypass barriers that block European competitors, securing access to exclusive, high-quality beans.

name: Oleksandr Kravchenko
hook: The Code of Coffee. A Senior Software Engineer (20+ Years Exp.) who treats recipes like code. He applies IT rigor to brewing to ensure automated consistency in every cup, eliminating the need for "Star Baristas" in every franchise unit.
title: The Architect of Taste – Precision, Protocol, and Scale
bioHtml:
• The Senior Expert: Oleks brings a level of analytical depth rare in the startup world. With a 20-year career as a Senior Software Engineer, he has been with Rasa Group since Day 1. He combines the brain of a systems architect with the palate of a SCA-certified barista.

  • Coffee as Code: Oleks shares the vision of a fully automated company. He treats a coffee recipe exactly like software deployment: it must be documented, tested, and bug-free.

  • Scalable Standardization: He creates the Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for the entire group. If a step isn't efficient or value-adding, it is deleted. This ensures that the hardware always performs at 100% and the product tastes the same in Dubai as it does in Berlin.

  • Strategic R&D: Together with Osman, he selected the Unica Pro system and established a direct feedback loop with manufacturers, positioning Rasa Group as an industry innovator, not just a customer.

name: Galih Racka
hook: The Brand Voice. From corporate strategist to digital authority. Galih bridges the gap between Indonesia’s soul and the Global Market, applying "Big Corp" structure to high-growth storytelling.
title: Orchestrating Global Reach – Influence, Structure, and Culture
bioHtml:
• The Corporate Masterclass: Galih possesses a strategic edge that investors value. He held a key position at Indomie—Indonesia’s most successful global FMCG export—specifically to study how a giant corporation operates. He is now applying those processes, structural discipline, and scaling strategies directly to Rasa Group.

  • Influence & Entrepreneurship: Before corporate life, Galih built his own teams and audiences from zero, currently holding over 100k+ followers. He doesn't guess what works; he has proven data.

  • The Cultural Bridge: As an Indonesian living in the GCC, Galih is strategically positioned. He understands the authentic roots of the product and the expectations of the international market. He ensures that Rasa Group is not just a coffee shop, but a globally recognized brand with a consistent voice.

name: Defieani Putri
hook: The Consumer Psychologist. Engineers desire. She uses behavioral science to create menus—like Pandan & Martabak—that trigger comfort, increase retention, and drive higher average ticket sizes.
title: Culinary Innovation Meets Behavioral Science
bioHtml:
• Financial & Academic Foundation: Defie operates with the pragmatism of a business owner, having managed corporate finances before pivoting to Psychology. This allows her to look at gastronomy not just through flavor, but through profitability and human behavior.

  • The Psychology of the Menu: Defie applies Neuromarketing to the business. She designs pastries that trigger psychological "comfort" responses, increasing customer retention. Her visual strategy maximizes "appetite appeal," directly influencing the average basket size.

  • R&D – The Fusion Signatures: She leads the creation of unique products like Pandan Brownies and authentic Martabak. She ensures that Rasa offers distinct flavors that no competitor in Europe can replicate, creating a unique selling proposition (USP) for every franchisee.

name: Engelie Marie Romero
hook: The Scalable Authentic. Operational excellence meets radical authenticity. She translates complex heritage recipes into streamlined SOPs, ensuring "Grandma's Taste" can be reproduced by any kitchen staff, anywhere.
title: Operational Excellence Meets Radical Authenticity
bioHtml:
• The Entrepreneurial Mandate: Engelie joined Rasa Group not as an employee, but as a Co-Owner with a clear mission: to design a culinary system that works not just for one restaurant, but for fifty.

  • Systematized Authenticity: Engelie’s strength lies in operationalizing creativity. She traveled deep into Indonesian villages to learn "Original Home Taste" and then adapted these recipes for mass operations.

  • Strategic Menu Engineering: She bridges the gap between traditional heritage and modern street food. Her systems ensure that every dish served at Rasa Group is scalable in production but tastes like it was made with love in Java. This eliminates the need for expensive "Star Chefs" in franchise locations, optimizing labor costs.

name: Errol Widhavian
hook: The Ecosystem Architect. With 19 years of high-level dev experience (Starbucks, Blue Bird), Errol builds the "OS of Gastronomy"—our proprietary tech stack that secures data ownership and operational speed.
title: Building the "OS of Gastronomy" – From Starbucks APIs to SaaS
bioHtml:
• The Tech Veteran: Errol is a seasoned CTO with nearly two decades of experience. He developed Backend APIs for Starbucks Indonesia and Blue Bird Taxi—systems that handle millions of transactions with zero downtime.

  • Executing the "App First" Strategy: Errol leads the development of Rasa’s proprietary platform. Unlike competitors relying on third-party software, Errol builds in-house. This gives Rasa Group 100% ownership of customer data and the agility to adapt features overnight.

  • The "Amazon Strategy" (Future Value): Errol was recruited to execute a long-term vision: Building internal tools so robust they can eventually be decoupled and sold as a SaaS (Software as a Service) solution to other hospitality brands. This secures a future revenue stream for the group far beyond selling coffee.

name: Hasan Gedik
hook: The Evidence-Based Creator. He bridges the gap between clinical journals and social media. Hasan studies the science of nutrition to validate our menu and educates our community on why our quality matters for their health.
title: Turning Clinical Science into Consumer Trust
bioHtml:
• The Scientific Filter: Hasan’s job starts where typical gastronomy stops: in academic libraries. He continuously screens medical journals and studies regarding coffee, tea, and nutrition. He uses this data to define strict "Veto-Lists" for ingredients we strictly refuse to use based on health concerns, ensuring Rasa remains a safe haven for the body.

  • Science-Based Content & Education: Hasan is the face of our "Why". He doesn't just say "our coffee is good"; he proves it. Through educational social media content, he breaks down complex biochemical processes—explaining, for example, why the specific processing of our Specialty Coffee reduces toxins and maximizes antioxidants compared to mass-market beans. He builds authority through facts.

  • Nutritional Engineering (Macros & Micros): He treats food and beverages as fuel. Working on our juice and food line, Hasan creates recipes not just by taste, but by nutritional profile. He perfectly balances macro- and micro-nutrients to create functional products that support focus, digestion, and vitality, validating the menu with his background in Public Health and Physiotherapy.
